title: El Castillo
blurb: The Temple of Kukulcan at Chichen Itza: a 30 meter Maya step pyramid with nine terraces and four stairways of 91 steps each. This detailed model builds every tread and balustrade capstone, the summit temple with its perforated roofcomb, the buried inner pyramid with the Chacmool and Red Jaguar Throne chambers, and the water filled cenote beneath the bedrock.

sourceUrls.label: El Castillo, Chichen Itza on Wikipedia

systems.name: Base and Platforms
systems.description: Basal plinth, summit floor plate, and plaza paving framing the pyramid.

systems.name: Terrace Shells
systems.description: Battered talud wall panels forming the nine stepped faces.

systems.name: Terrace Decks and Cores
systems.description: Walking decks and rubble core masses behind each terrace face.

systems.name: Grand Stairways
systems.description: Four radial stairs of 91 treads each, built tread by tread.

systems.name: Balustrade Ramps
systems.description: Sloped parapet ramps with capstone rows flanking every stair.

systems.name: Serpent Sculpture
systems.description: Plumed serpent carvings and the equinox shadow marker.

systems.name: Summit Temple
systems.description: The Temple of Kukulcan crowning the pyramid, with its roofcomb.

systems.name: Inner Substructure
systems.description: The buried earlier pyramid and its offering chambers, revealed in exploded view.

systems.name: Foundation and Hydrology
systems.description: Limestone bedrock and the water filled cenote below.

systems.name: Astronomy and Orientation
systems.description: Sightlines and markers for the documented solar alignments.
